lead: Akshay Kumar is a widely followed Indian film actor, born on 9 September 1967 in New Delhi.
As of 2026, he is 58 years old, and his birth date places him under the Virgo sign.
He is associated with work such as Entertainment, Khiladi and Rustom and has been recognised with Padma Shri in arts and National Film Award for Best Actor.
Below you will find a verified overview of Akshay Kumar: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Akshay Kumar — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Akshay Kumar was born on 9 September 1967 in New Delhi, and holds Indian and Canadian nationality.
